successors.name: Kingdom of Thomond
successors.text: Thomond, 'ruled by the O Briain': 'in much later times' equivalent to County Clare, with parts of Limerick and Tipperary (Thomond article)

successors.name: Kingdom of Desmond
successors.text: Desmond, 'ruled by the Mac Carthaigh': all of County Cork and most of County Kerry (Desmond article)

ledger.x: The kingdom of Munster: infobox 'Established: 1st century BC' (legendary); the Corcu Loigde fell from power in the 6th century and 'By the 7th century, the Eoganachta had eclipsed the Corcu Loigde and all others for hegemony in Munster'.
1118: Desmond goes to the Mac Carthaigh.

wars.name: Battle of Glanmire and the partition of Munster
wars.outcome: Mac Carthaigh victory at Glanmire; the Treaty of Glanmire divided Munster between O Briain (Thomond) and Mac Carthaigh (Desmond).

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary; the province is the best reading and Osraige moves with the 9th century.
